name: Ring of Regeneration

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes (if you have at least 1); lost body parts grow back.
text: While you are at 1 Hit Point or higher, the ring restores 1d6 Hit Points to you each 10 minutes. It can also regrow a lost body part, which becomes fully functional after 1d6 + 1 days, provided you never drop below 1 Hit Point in that time.
